channel.title: Signet Artists | Blog
channel.description: We’re Signet Artists in Denver, and we write now and then about live music for private events, including how to plan it, what it costs and the music itself.

item.title: Why does music bring back memories?
item.description: Why does music bring back memories? Here's what studies found about memory, nostalgia and 'our song', and how you can use it at an anniversary party.

item.title: Why do restaurants have live music?
item.description: Why do restaurants have live music? Here's what studies found about how long guests stay, what they spend and how loud the music should be.

item.title: Why do people sing along?
item.description: Wondering why people sing along at concerts and parties? We looked at a study of 1,054 songs and at whether singing together brings people closer.

item.title: Why do people play music at funerals?
item.description: Why is music part of a funeral? Here's what studies say about how families choose the song, what people often pick, and whether it has to be a hymn.

item.title: Why do dementia patients remember music?
item.description: Why do people with dementia often remember old songs? Here's what a song can bring back, which songs last, and what researchers found music can't do for memory.

item.title: What music do 80 year olds listen to?
item.description: What music do 80 and 90 year olds like? Here's the research on the years people remember best and how to find out what one person loves.

item.title: Sing-along songs for seniors
item.description: Here are sing-along songs for seniors from our own song list, how to choose more by the years your residents grew up in, and what studies found.

item.title: Last song of the night at a wedding
item.description: Does the last song of the night at a wedding matter? Here's what research says about endings, and how couples choose an upbeat or a slow last song.

item.title: Karaoke team building
item.description: Is karaoke good for team building? We look at what studies of singing together show, what they don't show, and how live band karaoke fits in.

item.title: Does music make food taste better?
item.description: Does music make food taste better? Here's what studies found about noise and taste, music and wine, and the best music for a dinner party.

item.title: Party music for all ages
item.description: Planning party music for all ages? Here's what research says about the decades each generation remembers best, with a table by guest age.

item.title: Live music for memory care residents
item.description: What can live music do for memory care residents, and what can't it do? Here's what research says about engagement, the right songs and hearing.

item.title: Is live music better than recorded?
item.description: Is live music better than recorded? Studies found people move more and feel more connected to each other at a live show. Here's what holds up.

item.title: How to get people to dance at a wedding
item.description: Wondering how to get people to dance at a wedding? Research on real dance floors points to songs people know, the tempo they move to, bass and live bands.

item.title: How does music affect people at a party?
item.description: How does music affect people at a party? We checked what research shows about volume, dancing, age, live music and drinking, and which claims don't hold up.

item.title: Does loud music make people drink more?
item.description: Does loud music make people drink more? The best-known study is small and comes from a lab whose work is in question. Here's what the research shows.

item.title: Do sound baths work?
item.description: Do sound baths work? People report feeling calmer and less tense, and small studies agree, but no health benefit is proven. Here's what the research says.

item.title: What is yacht rock?
item.description: What yacht rock is: the smooth soft rock of the late 1970s and early 80s, why it's called that, the songs, and how to throw a yacht rock party.

item.title: What is Americana music?
item.description: Learn what Americana music is, how it differs from country, folk and bluegrass, who the artists are, and which size of Americana band to book.

item.title: What is a string quartet?
item.description: A string quartet is two violins, a viola and a cello. Here's what each one plays, how a trio compares, and the songs strings play for the walk down the aisle.
